_comment: The v3 bank's architecture note 3 is the contract: 'Scenario stays fixed within
a transition even across pedagogy switches after a failed assessment; only
pedagogy style and assessment question-set change.'
A retry is a failure followed by another teaching turn, not a new case. The case
may only change when the pedagogy pool is exhausted and the tutor intervenes; at
that point the scenario is *supposed* to change because the learner moves to the
These checks compare the exact scenario_text bytes and the case id across turns,
and verify the question variant rotates instead of repeating.

checks.action: fail the C1 target twice with two different pedagogies
assertions: case_id == '1A' after the first failure and after the second
scenario_text after the second failure is byte-identical to after the first
title == 'Border Aggression' throughout

checks.action: fail until the pedagogy pool is exhausted
assertions: the three teaching turns use three distinct pedagogy names
the fourth draw returns None / 'All pedagogies tried'
used_pool has three entries and no duplicates

checks.action: collect the checkpoint question on four successive visits to the same case
assertions: the first three questions are the case's three question_variants, each once
the fourth visit wraps to the first variant (round-robin after exhaustion)
no variant repeats before all three have been served

checks.action: exhaust all three pedagogies on each case in turn
assertions: after intervention on 1A the case_id becomes '1B' and the scenario_text differs
after intervention on 1B the case_id becomes '1C' and the scenario_text differs
the reused question index is cleared for the new case
after intervention the pedagogy pool is a fresh 3 and used_pool is empty

checks.action: exhaust all three pedagogies on the last case of the transition
assertions: recovery kind is 'manual_review'
case_id is still '1C' and scenario_text is unchanged
session is preserved: history and prior attempts remain readable
no further teaching turn is served

checks.action: fail the C2 target, then pass on a second pedagogy
assertions: case_id remains '2A' across the retry
scenario_text is byte-identical across the retry
the passing retry advances to C2's next transition (C3), not to 2B

question_variant_case_samples._comment: Every case must supply at least three variants for rotation to be observable.
